shop.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a clean 3D-generation input sheet of the blue-awning corner shop in these two approved original concept images. Faithfully retain warm pale limestone/plaster facade, bevelled masonry corner pilasters, blue-green window frames, cobalt fabric awnings, dark wooden glazed entrance, two storeys plus terracotta mansard roof with dormers, restrained green window rails. Choose a consistent rectangular building with a chamfered street-facing front-right corner; front has display window left and wooden door right; chamfer has narrow display; right side has two display bays; upper window axes correspond to lower bays. Front two dormers and side two dormers. Rear is a modest service elevation using same materials with plain service door and windows, no shop awning on rear. Rear is inferred, keep simple. Remove all people, cards, street, signboard, planters and neighboring buildings. Roof and eaves fully inside every panel. Orthographic front/side/back, 3/4 from front right. Soft neutral even lighting, crisp anime environment materials, low noise masonry and tile detailing, preserve reference massing and palette. No dramatic cast shadows or scenery. Do not vary window counts or proportions across views. High resolution landscape sheet.

Neutral uniform light gray background, objects isolated without pavement base or walls, soft even studio light, no people no cards no scenery no text except view labels. First three views orthographic, three-quarter shows front and right. Whole lamp visible with comfortable margin, every group same overall height. Clean stylized geometry, matte materials, original concept fidelity. High-resolution landscape sheet.
